svg.title: macOS · Gallery · tile menu with Select Multiple and Select All · 1280×800
svg.desc: gallery.svg with the tile's right-click menu open over tile 2 (App/GalleryGridContent.swift tileContextMenu), as of 2026-09-13: Open · New blended clip · ─ · Select Multiple · Select All · ─ · Edit · Show in Finder · ─ · Delete…. The two new entries are the keyboard-free doors onto multi-selection (gallery.batch.svg): Select Multiple turns selection mode on — every tile wears an empty 22 pt circle top-leading and a tap toggles the tile, the header becoming Done · "Select projects" · Select All — and reads Done Selecting while the mode is on; Select All ticks every tile the sidebar and the search leave visible, and is disabled once they all are. Neither entry selects the tile the menu was opened on. Everything behind the menu is gallery.svg unchanged. The same menu is the long-press menu on iOS (iOS/gallery.menu.portrait.svg), without Show in Finder. Drawn from the shipped code (87b1f35), verified on the simulator and by Steven on his Mac.
svg.text: macOS · Gallery · tile menu — Select Multiple · Select All · 1280×800 pt window
the right-click menu's two new entries: Select Multiple puts the empty circle on every tile, Select All ticks the filtered grid
